title: stormslayer's textures
description: a pvp pack themed on a team im in on a server called raid farms.
body:
a texture pack im working on (currently unfinnished but updates will release) that will be a pvp pack with custom rename textures and easter eggs for the team i play on in a server called raidfarms!!!!!!!!!

the current renames are:

fire sword (rename a diamond sword)
storm totem, Mischievous Keepsake (rename a totem)
ferdinand (rename a netherite sword)

other texture changes are:

short swords
armour with the flag of my team
minimal water
highlighted ores (iron ore, diamond ore and their deepslate varients)
highlighted netherite
less busy overlays (e.g. the enchantment overlay and water overlay)
